sources.content: Mintervale .cursorrules. Mintervale is a search indexing service that turns product catalog updates into documents for an inverted index. Language: Kotlin 2.0 on JVM 21, built with Gradle. Use `./gradlew build` to compile and `./gradlew test` to run tests. Integration tests are tagged `@Tag("slow")` and run only with `./gradlew slowTest`. The indexer reads updates from the topic `catalog.changes` and writes batches of at most 500 documents. Configuration lives in `app/src/main/resources/application.yaml`; never hard code hostnames.

Style for Mintervale code. Prefer data classes for messages and sealed classes for results. Do not use `!!` in production code. Coroutines are allowed only in the `ingest` module. Every new analyzer, such as a stemmer or synonym filter, needs a test file in `analyzers/src/test` with at least one non-English example. Log with SLF4J, never `println`. Public classes need KDoc. When you change the document schema, bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` in `Schema.kt` and add a reindex note to `docs/reindex.md`.

claims.text: Changing the Mintervale document schema requires bumping SCHEMA_VERSION.
Mintervale writes index batches of at most 500 documents.
Mintervale allows coroutines only in the ingest module.
